tickerText: [TENNIS] Rolex Shanghai Masters Saturday: Zverev faces Davidovich Fokina and teen sensation Rafael Jodar meets Daniil Medvedev in the ATP semifinals, while WTA Wuhan sends Kartal–Ostapenko and Świątek–Chwalinska into the last four • [SQUASH] CIB Egyptian Open crowns new champions at the Pyramids: Diego Elías edges Mostafa Asal 3–2 and Amina Orfi sweeps Hania El Hammamy 3–0 on finals night in Giza • [BADMINTON] VICTOR Denmark Open Saturday: Victor Lai, Alex Lanier, Anders Antonsen and Christo Popov fill the men’s semifinals; An Se-young, Okuhara, Yamaguchi and Wang Zhiyi lead the women’s penultimate round in Odense • [PICKLEBALL] Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open moves into pro semifinals Saturday with noon gates and PickleballTV all day plus Tennis Channel from noon–3 p.m. ET • [TABLE TENNIS] ITTF World Hopes Challenge opens in Sheffield as 36 under-12 prospects from 26 nations begin the giant round-robin on Day 1 ahead of Sunday’s awards

newsItems.title: Denmark Open Semifinal Saturday
newsItems.excerpt: Odense sets a blockbuster men’s last four of Lai–Lanier and Antonsen–Popov after Friday’s quarterfinals, while An Se-young, Okuhara, Yamaguchi and Wang Zhiyi chase women’s semifinal berths at the VICTOR Denmark Open.

newsItems.title: Virginia Beach Semifinal Day
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Tour’s Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open hits pro semifinals Saturday at Pickleball Virginia Beach, with gates at noon and live coverage on PickleballTV plus Tennis Channel through mid-afternoon.

newsItems.title: Shanghai & Wuhan Semifinals
newsItems.excerpt: ATP Shanghai’s Saturday card pairs top seed Zverev with Davidovich Fokina and Jodar with Medvedev, while WTA Wuhan’s semifinals feature Kartal–Ostapenko and an all-Polish clash between Świątek and Chwalinska.

newsItems.title: Hopes Challenge Begins
newsItems.excerpt: The ITTF World Hopes Week in Sheffield turns competitive Saturday as 36 U12 players from 26 member associations open the two-day Challenge round-robin at the English Institute of Sport.
